meta.name: skillify
meta.description: Capture this session's repeatable process into a reusable skill. Call at end of a process you want to automate.

copy.tagline: 把当前操作流程保存为可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常重复做同一套操作想一键复用
copy.tagline_en: Save your current workflow as a reusable skill
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat the same steps and want to reuse them with one click

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析当前对话，帮你把重复的工作流程（比如代码审查、发布步骤）变成一个可复用的技能文件。它会一步步问你细节，然后自动生成 SKILL.md 文件并保存。
howto.when: 当你想把当前会话中的工作流程保存为可复用的技能时触发。例如你说“/skillify”、“把这个保存为技能”、“让这个流程可重复”等。

say.text: 把刚才的代码审查流程保存为技能。
say.note: Claude 会分析对话并开始提问。

say.text: /skillify 将 PR 合并到 release 分支的步骤。
say.note: 直接触发技能创建，并附带描述。

say.text: 保存这个工作流，让它可重复使用。
say.note: Claude 会启动技能创建流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes the current conversation to turn your repeatable workflow (e.g., code review, release steps) into a reusable skill file. It asks you for details step by step, then generates and saves the SKILL.md file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to capture and save the current session's workflow as a reusable skill. Examples: '/skillify', 'capture this as a skill', 'save this workflow', 'make this repeatable'.

say_en.text: Save the code review process we just did as a skill.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the conversation and start asking questions.

say_en.text: /skillify steps to merge a PR to release branch.
say_en.note: Directly triggers skill creation with a description.

say_en.text: Save this workflow so I can reuse it later.
say_en.note: Claude will start the skill creation process.
